name: Default
shortDescription: LLM companion for Paperless-ngx that suggests titles, tags, correspondents, dates and custom fields, runs LLM-based OCR and links related documents.

alerts.message: Replace the placeholder PAPERLESS_API_TOKEN and OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment variables, point PAPERLESS_BASE_URL at your Paperless-ngx instance and set PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL to its public address so document links open, then redeploy. The default PAPERLESS_BASE_URL reaches a Paperless-ngx template deployed in the same environment. To use Anthropic, Mistral, Google AI or Ollama instead, change LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_MODEL and the vision settings and fill in that provider's key or OLLAMA_HOST.
paperless-gpt has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with PAPERLESS_GPT_USERNAME and PAPERLESS_GPT_PASSWORD from the environment variables.
